parts.name: Plate Block
parts.info: Plain armoured cube. The backbone of every hull.

parts.name: Half Plate
parts.info: A half-height plate for flush floors and thin skins.

parts.name: Slope Plate
parts.info: A ramp wedge. Turns a boxy nose into a blade.

parts.name: Corner Cap
parts.info: Tri-sided corner that closes a slope neatly.

parts.name: Spike Cap
parts.info: Four-sided point. Good for prows and ram spikes.

parts.name: Round Pillar
parts.info: Eight-sided column. Stack them into a fuselage.

parts.name: Nose Cone
parts.info: Tapers to a point toward the front of the ship.

parts.name: Round Cap
parts.info: A smooth half-dome for rounding off a hull.

parts.name: Wing Plate
parts.info: Thin flat wing section. Helps the ship bank.

parts.name: Swept Blade
parts.info: Swept-back wing tip. Point the long edge forward.

parts.name: Tail Fin
parts.info: Upright fin. Keeps the ship pointed where you aim it.

parts.name: Long Spar
parts.info: Thin rod that runs the whole cell. Struts and antennae.

parts.name: Bolt Cannon
parts.info: Reliable single barrel. Fires toward the front of the block.

parts.name: Twin Bolt
parts.info: Two barrels in one block. Twice the noise.

parts.name: Dome Turret
parts.info: A turret on a round base. Covers the top and bottom of the ship.

parts.name: Rocket Pod
parts.info: Four launch tubes. Big bang, short reach.

parts.name: Beam Lance
parts.info: A long precision beam. Drains reactor power.

parts.name: Ion Thruster
parts.info: Compact engine. Nozzle faces the back of the block.

parts.name: Burn Booster
parts.info: Fat afterburner. Fast and thirsty.

parts.name: Vector Nozzle
parts.info: Steerable exhaust for tight turns.

parts.name: Twin Ion
parts.info: Two small engines side by side.

parts.name: Gyro Ring
parts.info: Spinning disc. Lets the ship roll and flip.

parts.name: Command Dome
parts.info: Pilot seat under a glass dome. Every ship needs one.

parts.name: Glass Canopy
parts.info: Streamlined cockpit with a swept glass roof.

parts.name: Fusion Core
parts.info: Powers your weapons and engines.

parts.name: Cell Stack
parts.info: A cheap block of stored power.

parts.name: Ward Emitter
parts.info: Projects a barrier that soaks hits.

parts.name: Cargo Tank
parts.info: Fuel and cargo drum. Tough and cheap.

parts.name: Radar Mast
parts.info: Sensor dish on a pole. Improves handling.
